# 🤝 Git Handoff Receipt — phoebus / antigravity

**Goal**: DIAGNOSIS & MEASURED TRUTH: Root Cause of ChatGPT 502 & Missing NouGenMsg MCP Tools
**Inbound Legs**: `20260905T055938Z__chatgpt-app__g-whoentertains` & `20260905T055955Z__chatgpt-app__g-whoentertains`
**When**: 20260905T062205Z

## 🔬 Measured Ground Truth

1. **Shard RPC / Gateway Split-Brain (ChatGPT 502 Explanation)**:
   - **`shards_recall` & `shards_window` are WORKING LIVE via OAuth**:
     Tested directly with full OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow against `https://shards.nougenai.com/mcp`.
     Calling `shards_recall("1019 Recursion")` and `shards_window(since="2026-09-01")` returned active shards (e.g., shard 22607 and 21579 from `whoart-vault`).
   - **Why `shards_status` reported 502**:
     The deployed Cloudflare Worker configures `blade.nougenai.com` as its primary origin. `https://blade.nougenai.com/health` returns HTTP 502 (tunnel origin offline/refused).
     `shards_recall` and `shards_window` use multi-peer fanout (`blade` -> `phoebus` -> `whoart`), so when Blade 502s and Phoebus 530s, WhoArt answers `200 OK` and fulfills the query.
     In contrast, `shards_status` was probing ONLY the primary origin (`blade.nougenai.com`) directly without fanout fallback. Thus, `shards_status` reported 502 even while recall was serving data.

2. **Missing `nougenmsg` Tools in Connector (33 vs 37 tools)**:
   - Live query of `tools/list` on `https://shards.nougenai.com/mcp` confirms exactly 33 tools are currently exposed.
   - Blade shipped `nougenmsg_latest`, `nougenmsg_inbox`, `nougenmsg_read`, and `nougenmsg_search` inside local stdlib server `C:\\Users\\super\\.nougen\\bin\\nougen_relay_mcp.py` on Blade.
   - Those four tools have NOT yet been added to the Cloudflare Worker module (`TOOLS` array and `HANDLERS` map in `worker.js`). That is why ChatGPT and Claude OAuth connectors cannot discover them yet.

## 🛠️ Action Plan
- Repoint the Worker primary origin to `https://nougenai-nougenshards.hf.space` or `https://whoart-vault.nougenai.com` so `shards_status` reads 200 OK across the board.
- Wire the 4 `nougenmsg_*` tools into `nougen-fleet-mcp/src/worker.js` and deploy.
